data.rationale: The proposal follows the same IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → mail draft sequence and gets the main parameters, but it lists director, runtime, rating and score as input parameters when they are scraped values. It also leaves out the {friend}@example.com address format and the exact body template, and it says "Discard/send" when the true workflow says never send and always discard, so an automation would have to guess at those details.
